name: lens
title: Lens
description: A circle follows the cursor and reveals a second layer underneath: sketch under final, night under day, before under after.

meta.reducedMotion: The lens jumps to the cursor without easing; a "Show the other layer" toggle shows the second layer at full size.
meta.useWhen: The two layers are the story (process, transformation, hidden detail).
meta.avoidWhen: The second layer is decoration; text-heavy layers; more than one per page.
